summary: Frontend-only retest of the CRITICAL WalletModal stacking bug (iteration_1). Fix verified: WalletModal is now createPortal'd to document.body (hit-test confirmed connect-demo-btn is topmost element at its center and lives outside #root). At 390px a NORMAL Playwright click (no force, no JS injection) on wallet-connect-btn -> connect-demo-btn completed the full SIWE demo flow: header shows shortened address 0xa046…130e, uid-status-row shows user-uid TTN100012 with Inactive activation-status badge, modal auto-closed (count 0), success toast 'Connected · TTN100012'. Session persistence verified (localStorage titan_wallet_address set; after reload wallet still connected and uid re-fetched). Modal close via X and via overlay both work; connect-walletconnect-btn correctly disabled ('Add a Project ID to enable'). Bottom nav: Stake/Pools/Mining/My Team render the coming-soon placeholder with the right module numbers; Dashboard renders dashboard cards. No horizontal overflow at 360/390/430. No console errors, no error elements.

issues: 'Total Activated Users' shows 0 while the secondary label says '12 joined' — correct per data (all demo users inactive) but the 0-vs-12 juxtaposition reads as a bug to users; consider clarifying copy (e.g. '0 activated of 12 joined').

critical_code_review_comments: WalletModal portal fix is correct; keep any future overlays (toasts/sheets/dialogs) portaled to document.body so App.js's `relative z-10` wrapper can't trap them again.
Dashboard has no data-testid on its root container (only card-level testids); adding data-testid="dashboard" would make tab-switch assertions cleaner.
Minor: /api/auth/nonce is still single-doc-per-address (in-flight nonce invalidated by a new request) and unrated-limited — noted in iteration_1, not re-tested.
seed_data_creation: One new SIWE demo user created via connect-demo-btn: UID TTN100012 (address 0xa046311531a04238cb30bdf9ba1ec6d0b935130e)
test_credentials: Wallet-based only; demo wallet button (random ethers wallet signs SIWE)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_1's CRITICAL modal stacking bug is RESOLVED and re-verified with normal clicks. Remaining untested by design: connect-walletconnect-btn (disabled, no project id) and connect-injected-btn (no extension in the test browser). Backend suite: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -q`.
rca_of_the_issue: Original RCA (stacking context trap from App.js `div.relative z-10`) confirmed resolved by rendering the modal through createPortal to document.body, which places the z-[100] overlay in the root stacking context above BottomNav (z-50).
